title: Doorway handoff — Immediate response
title_zh: 门口交接 — 即时处理
scenario: At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.
required_zh: Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Doorway handoff”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

title: Doorway handoff — Working alone
title_zh: 门口交接 — 独自工作
scenario: At a residential care doorway, a child starts moving toward another room. A household adult says they can watch briefly, but their eligibility has not been established. You are still responsible for the group. In this version the setting is a family child-care home, and you are the only qualified caregiver on site. No approved second caregiver is immediately available.
scenario_zh: 住宅托育的门口，一名孩子开始走向另一个房间。家中成人说可以暂时帮忙看，但资格未确认，你仍负责全组。本题设在家庭托育场所，现场只有你一位合格照护者，没有已确认可立即接手的第二个人。
question: As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？
required: Keep responsibility for the child and group. Do not send the child through the doorway without a verified eligible person clearly accepting care. Use the safe approved area and the permitted contingency plan if safe care cannot continue.
required_zh: 继续负责这个孩子和全组。没有已核实合格人员明确接手，就不让孩子独自进入另一房间。使用可安全照看的获准区域，不能继续安全照护时启用允许的应变安排。
practical: Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.
practical_zh: 你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

question: As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

question: As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？交接前，代班人员必须能说清什么、找到什么？

title: Doorway handoff — Preventing a repeat

title: Birthday transition — Immediate response
title_zh: 生日与年龄段 — 即时处理
scenario: A child's birthday falls this week. A worker immediately moves the child into an older age category on the staffing sheet and plans to reduce coverage. The program has not checked whether the applicable rule allows that change on that date. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 一名孩子这周过生日。员工立刻在人员安排表上把他改到较大年龄组，并准备减少看护人员。机构还没查明，现行规则是否允许当天这样调整。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, what would you verify before changing this child's category or reducing staffing? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，改变年龄分类或减少人员前，你会先核实什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Do not reduce staff just because a birthday occurred. Check the age definition and any transition conditions in the applicable rule.
required_zh: 不要只因儿童过生日就减少人员。先查适用的年龄定义和转组条件。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Birthday transition”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A birthday does not by itself explain all staffing conditions. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“生日与年龄段”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。过生日，不代表所有人员安排条件都自动改变。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify capacity, age bands, group size, and counting rules for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证容量、年龄段、组别人数与计算规则。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

question: As the family child-care provider, what would you verify before changing this child's category or reducing staffing? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

scenario: During a schedule review, the director finds that a required training record has expired. The worker is still assigned to a shift that relies on that qualification. Someone suggests leaving the schedule unchanged because renewal has been booked. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 检查排班时，园长发现一项所需培训证明已过期，这名员工仍被安排在需要该资格的时段。有人建议不要改排班，因为已经预约续训。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, how would you cover today's shift and resolve the expired training record without misrepresenting eligibility? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，今天的班次怎样补位，又怎样处理过期培训而不把资格写成已满足？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Check who still has the needed valid training and change the schedule if necessary. Book the required renewal; do not alter the old certificate.
required_zh: 查看谁仍持有效培训证明，必要时调整排班并安排续训，不修改旧证书日期。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Expired training”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A schedule is safe only when required qualifications remain covered. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“培训过期”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。排班需要保证所需资格始终有人具备。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify required training, renewal, and coverage rules for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

question: As the family child-care provider, how would you resolve a possible duplicate dose without guessing and identify the correct clinical advice route? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?

required: Do not give another dose to fill a blank record. Keep the child supervised and contact the qualified clinical advice route in the medication plan; use emergency services for urgent symptoms.

scenario: A family sends an updated meal instruction to the office. The adult preparing and serving lunch has not received it, and the old meal list remains in use. The office considers the change complete because the message was filed. A helper offers to deal with the issue, but their eligibility for child care or confidential information has not been checked. Other staff assume willingness is enough.
scenario_zh: 家庭把新的饮食说明发给办公室，但备餐和上餐成人没收到，旧名单还在使用。办公室觉得消息已经归档，变更就算完成。有人愿意帮忙，但其承担儿童照护或接触保密资料的资格尚未核实。其他员工觉得热心就够了。
question: As the family child-care provider, how would you make sure the adult serving today's meal actually receives and understands the change? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样确认今天实际上餐的人收到并理解了饮食变更？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？
required: Update the child's meal instructions and ask the serving adult to repeat the change. A message in an unread inbox does not protect the child at lunch.
required_zh: 更新儿童的饮食说明，并让实际备餐、上餐人员复述变更内容。
practical: Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.
practical_zh: 只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Diet change message”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An unread message does not change what reaches a child's plate. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“饮食变化信息”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。消息没人看到，儿童餐盘里的食物就不会随之改变。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify allergy plans, food handling, and emergency response for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证过敏计划、食品处理与应急响应规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Missing supplies — Unverified helper
title_zh: 用品不足 — 帮手职责未核实
scenario: A child is already on the changing surface when the caregiver discovers the supplies are across the room. The caregiver plans to walk away briefly. Another child also needs attention nearby. A helper offers to deal with the issue, but their eligibility for child care or confidential information has not been checked. Other staff assume willingness is enough.
scenario_zh: 孩子已经在换尿布台上，照护者才发现用品放在房间另一侧。他准备短暂走开，旁边另一个孩子也需要帮助。有人愿意帮忙，但其承担儿童照护或接触保密资料的资格尚未核实。其他员工觉得热心就够了。
question: As the family child-care provider, what would you do with the child now, and how would you prevent the supply problem from recurring? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，现在怎样安顿孩子，又怎样防止用品没备齐的问题重演？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？
required: Gather supplies before starting. If something is missing, keep the child safely attended and use a safe alternative; do not walk away from the changing surface.
required_zh: 开始前备齐用品；缺东西时也要保持儿童安全有人照看，不能转身走开。
practical: Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.
practical_zh: 只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Missing supplies”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Leaving a child on a changing surface creates an immediate fall risk. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“用品不足”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。让儿童独自留在换尿布台上，会造成跌落危险。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify hand hygiene, diapering, toileting, and sanitation for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证手部卫生、换尿布、如厕与消毒规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

No approved second caregiver is immediately available.

question: As the family child-care provider, how would you secure and resolve the unidentified product without sniffing or guessing its contents? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样收好并处理不明产品，而不闻、不猜内容？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

required_zh: 停止使用无标签瓶并安全收好，不闻、不猜，按正式方法识别或处置。
practical: Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.
practical_zh: 你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Unmarked spray”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Guessing the contents of an unmarked bottle can create a new exposure. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

scenario: A surface is sprayed and immediately wiped dry. Nobody has checked the product's required wet contact time or full use directions. question: As the family child-care provider, what product directions must be checked before this task can be considered properly completed? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?

required: Read the product label and keep the surface wet for the specified time. A quick wipe may not complete the intended treatment.

practical: Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Short contact time”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A saved summary appears to support a different response. Its effective date, license category and any exceptions have not been established.
scenario_zh: 员工发现孩子身上有印记，却没人见到何时出现。大家各自猜原因，有人想把“可能是撞的”写成亲眼见到的事实。一份旧摘要似乎支持不同做法，但生效日期、许可类别和例外均未查清。
question: As director, what care and factual record are needed when the cause of a mark is unknown? Which issuing-source text and program facts would you need before changing the legal conclusion?
question_zh: 作为园长，伤痕原因未知时，需要提供什么照护，又怎样作真实记录？改变法律判断前，要取得什么签发机构原文和项目事实？
required: Record where the mark is and when it was noticed. Get appropriate care, preserve the child's exact words if offered, and assess reporting duties without inventing a cause.
required_zh: 记录伤痕位置和发现时间，提供适当照护，不编造原因；同时核查保护性报告义务。
practical: Identify the current issuing authority, exact license category and relevant program. Obtain the effective primary text and check scope, exceptions, required action, recipient and timing. Keep the general safety response in place; the jurisdiction-specific answer remains unresolved here.
practical_zh: 确认当前签发机构、准确许可类别和相关项目，取得有效原文，核对范围、例外、行动、对象和时限。继续保持一般安全措施；本版尚不能确定具体法律结论。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Uncertain injury timing”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An unexplained mark does not establish how an injury happened. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“受伤时间不明”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。不明伤痕，不能直接证明受伤原因。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify emergency care, incident documentation, and reporting for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证急救照护、事故记录与报告规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Uncertain threshold — Substitute handoff
title_zh: 报告门槛不确定 — 代班交接
scenario: A caregiver is uncertain whether the known facts meet the reporting threshold. A colleague advises gathering enough proof before contacting anyone. No official reporting guidance has yet been consulted. A qualified substitute is due to take over later. They know the usual routine but have not been told what happened, which safeguards are in place or what remains unresolved.
scenario_zh: 照护者拿不准已知事实是否达到报告门槛。同事建议证据足够了再联系，大家还没向官方报告渠道确认要求。合格代班人员稍后接手。他熟悉平时作息，却不知道这次发生了什么、已做了哪些防护，以及什么还没解决。
question: As the family child-care provider, how would you clarify the reporting threshold without making proof-gathering a barrier to a required report? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样确认报告门槛，而不把收集证据变成已要求报告的障碍？交接前，代班人员必须能说清什么、找到什么？
required: Use the official reporting authority to clarify uncertainty promptly. Do not collect proof first or let consultation delay a report already required by the applicable law.
required_zh: 不确定时及时向官方报告机构确认；不要先自行收集证据，也不能因此拖延已经要求的报告。
practical: Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.
practical_zh: 交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Uncertain threshold”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Reporting thresholds are not the same as proving an allegation. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“报告门槛不确定”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。报告门槛，不等于证明指控属实。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify mandated reporting, confidentiality, and protective action for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证强制报告、保密与保护行动规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Accommodation dismissed — Preventing a repeat

scenario: A family requests a change that would help a child participate in a routine activity. The worker rejects it because the usual routine would need to change. No individualized discussion or trial has taken place. A similar problem occurred recently and received a verbal reminder. The same workflow or equipment remains in use, and the problem has returned.
scenario_zh: 家庭提出一种帮助孩子参与日常活动的调整，员工因惯例要改变而拒绝。双方尚未作个人讨论，也没有试行。类似问题不久前发生过，当时只作口头提醒。流程或设备没有变化，问题又出现了。
question: As the family child-care provider, how would you assess the individual request and test a practical way for the child to participate? What measurable change would you make, who would own it and how would you check whether it works?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样审查个人请求，并试行能让孩子参与的实际办法？你会作什么可衡量改变、由谁负责，又怎样检查是否有效？
required: Ask what support the child needs and consider a workable change. For example, offer an accessible path to the activity instead of saying all children must use the same route.
required_zh: 先了解儿童需要，考虑可行调整，例如更粗的画笔手柄；不一概拒绝，也不未经分析全部承诺。
practical: Change the actual workflow, environment, information or coverage gap behind this event. Name an owner and check the safeguard during safe ordinary use or a simulation; do not recreate a hazard with a child.
practical_zh: 改变本事件背后的流程、环境、信息或人员缺口，明确负责人，在安全日常使用或模拟中检查效果，不让孩子再次冒险来测试。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Accommodation dismissed”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Equal participation may require different tools or arrangements. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“拒绝调整”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。平等参与，有时需要不同工具或安排。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify reasonable modifications, expulsion, notice, and nondiscrimination for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证合理调整、开除、通知与反歧视规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Water attraction — Family explanation

scenario: Children are drawn toward a water feature outside the planned play area. No activity-specific supervision, barrier or rescue arrangement has been confirmed. A worker says the feature is decorative, not a swimming pool. The affected family asks for an explanation and also requests details about another child or worker. Some facts are still unknown.
scenario_zh: 孩子被计划活动区外的水景吸引。相关看护、阻隔和救援安排尚未确认。员工认为只是装饰，不是游泳池。受影响家庭要求解释，也问到另一名孩子或员工的细节，其中部分事实仍未知。
question: As director, what access controls and activity-specific safety arrangements must be established before children approach the water? What would you tell the family now, what would remain private, and what separate notices might still be due?
question_zh: 作为园长，孩子靠近水域前，需要什么接触控制和活动专门安全安排？现在向家庭说明什么，哪些要保密，哪些另行通知责任仍需处理？
required: Keep children away from the water until the specific activity has a safe, permitted plan. A decorative pond still presents a water-access risk.
required_zh: 在具体水活动得到安全且允许的安排前，防止儿童接近水域；装饰水池也要考虑风险。
practical: Explain the verified facts relevant to that family’s child and what you actually did. State what remains unknown, restrict unrelated private details and handle any applicable official notice or report separately.
practical_zh: 说明与该家庭孩子有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知，限制无关隐私；另行处理适用的正式通知或报告。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Water attraction”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Unplanned water access can create danger even outside a scheduled swim. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“水景吸引”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。没有安排游泳时，接近水域仍可能有危险。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify playground, weather, water, and activity supervision for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证游乐场、天气、水域与活动监管规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title_zh: 新增住户 — 即时处理
scenario: A new adult moves into a home used for child care. The provider treats it as a private household change and has not checked screening or notification duties. The resident will have access to parts of the care environment. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 经营家庭托育的住所搬入一名新成人。经营者把这看成私事，尚未核对审查或通知责任。新住户能进入部分照护环境。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, what screening and notification questions must be resolved for this new resident and their actual access? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，针对新住户及其实际接触范围，需要解决哪些审查和通知问题？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Before assuming no action is needed, check the rules for the new resident's age and access. Record required screening and notifications without inventing a deadline.
required_zh: 按新住户年龄和接触范围核实所需审查、通知和时限；商业中心先判断是否适用家庭住户情境。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “New household member”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A new resident can change screening and notification requirements. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“新增住户”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。新增住户，可能影响审查和通知要求。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify household access, animals, weapons, approved areas, and household changes for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. This exercise uses household facts. For a commercial center without those facts, adapt the incident or record it as not applicable rather than importing residential duties.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证住户接触、动物、武器、批准区域与住户变化规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。本题使用家庭住户事实。不具备这些事实的商业中心，应改写情境或注明不适用，不能直接套用住宅要求。

title: Accessible restricted item — Immediate response
title_zh: 可接触的危险物 — 即时处理
scenario: A household item presenting a serious hazard is found in a care-accessible area. A worker places it on a higher shelf but has not checked the correct storage method. A child could still reach the area with nearby furniture. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 照护区域发现严重危险物。员工把它移到高架，却没查正确保管方法，孩子借旁边家具仍可能够到。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, what hazard-specific action would secure the item rather than merely move it higher? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样按具体危险收好物品，而不是只把它放高？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Move children away and secure the item using the correct method for that hazard. Do not leave a dangerous object on a high but reachable shelf and call it secure.
required_zh: 让儿童远离，按具体危险妥善处理。放高一点但仍能拿到，不等于安全收好。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

title: Accessible restricted item — Preventing a repeat

question: As the family child-care provider, what hazard-specific action would secure the item rather than merely move it higher? What measurable change would you make, who would own it and how would you check whether it works?

scenario: A subsidy authorization changes, but billing continues using the previous information. The effective date has not been matched to the billing period. The bookkeeper wants to overwrite the old entry rather than document a correction. A helper offers to deal with the issue, but their eligibility for child care or confidential information has not been checked. Other staff assume willingness is enough.
scenario_zh: 补助授权已变，账单仍用旧资料。生效日期还没与账期对应，记账人员想覆盖旧记录，而不是留下更正。有人愿意帮忙，但其承担儿童照护或接触保密资料的资格尚未核实。其他员工觉得热心就够了。
question: As the family child-care provider, how would you match the authorization's effective dates to the claim period and preserve the correction history? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，怎样把授权生效日期与申报期对应，并保留更正经过？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？
required: Match the authorization change to its effective dates and the billing period. Correct a claim through the approved process rather than overwrite history.
required_zh: 把新授权生效日期与账期对应，通过正式流程更正，不覆盖历史资料。
practical: Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.
practical_zh: 只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Authorization changed”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An authorization change applies to its actual effective period. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“授权变更”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。授权变更应按实际生效期间处理。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify the relevant subsidy program authorization, billing, attendance, and corrections for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证相关补助项目的授权、申报、出勤与更正规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Inspection access confusion — Family explanation
title_zh: 检查访问不明 — 向家庭说明
scenario: A person presents as an inspector while the manager is absent. Staff are unsure how to verify identity and arrange lawful access. One worker proposes a manager-only rule; another wants to provide records without verification. The affected family asks for an explanation and also requests details about another child or worker. Some facts are still unknown.
scenario_zh: 经理不在时，一人自称检查员到场。员工不知怎样核实和安排合法访问：有人想一律等经理，有人想不核实就交记录。受影响家庭要求解释，也问到另一名孩子或员工的细节，其中部分事实仍未知。
question: As director, how would you verify the inspector promptly and provide lawful access without disclosing to an unverified person? What would you tell the family now, what would remain private, and what separate notices might still be due?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样及时核实检查员并提供合法访问，同时不向未核实人员披露资料？现在向家庭说明什么，哪些要保密，哪些另行通知责任仍需处理？
required: Follow the official identity-check procedure promptly and arrange lawful access. Do not invent a manager-only rule that blocks an authorized inspection.
required_zh: 及时按官方方法核实检查员并提供合法访问，不自行设定必须经理在场才可检查。
practical: Explain the verified facts relevant to that family’s child and what you actually did. State what remains unknown, restrict unrelated private details and handle any applicable official notice or report separately.
practical_zh: 说明与该家庭孩子有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知，限制无关隐私；另行处理适用的正式通知或报告。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Inspection access confusion”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Identity checks should support lawful access, not create an invented barrier. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“检查访问不明”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。核实身份应支持合法检查，不能凭空增加障碍。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify license category, changes, inspections, corrections, and appeals for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证许可类别、变更、检查、整改与申诉规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Routine not implemented — Family explanation

scenario: The displayed program plan does not match the children's ordinary day. Staff repeat activities that do not serve the stated learning goals and do not revise the plan. The document is treated as inspection material rather than a working guide. The affected family asks for an explanation and also requests details about another child or worker. Some facts are still unknown.
scenario_zh: 展示的课程计划与孩子实际一天不符。员工重复与目标无关的活动，也不修改计划，只把文件当检查材料。受影响家庭要求解释，也问到另一名孩子或员工的细节，其中部分事实仍未知。
question: As director, how would you compare the plan with the children's actual experience and improve daily implementation? What would you tell the family now, what would remain private, and what separate notices might still be due?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样对照计划与儿童实际经历，改进日常执行？现在向家庭说明什么，哪些要保密，哪些另行通知责任仍需处理？
required: Compare the written routine with what children experience. Adjust the plan or daily practice so the learning goal is meaningful and the actual requirements are met.
required_zh: 对照实际日常活动和学习目标，适当调整计划或执行，并满足适用要求。
practical: Explain the verified facts relevant to that family’s child and what you actually did. State what remains unknown, restrict unrelated private details and handle any applicable official notice or report separately.
practical_zh: 说明与该家庭孩子有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知，限制无关隐私；另行处理适用的正式通知或报告。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Routine not implemented”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A displayed plan does not show what children actually experience. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“日程未落实”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。贴出的计划，不能证明儿童实际经历了什么。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify program planning, family communication, meals, rest, and individual needs for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证课程规划、家园沟通、用餐、休息与个人需求规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

title: Outdated handbook — Immediate response
title_zh: 手册过时 — 即时处理
scenario: Two policy versions remain in daily use, giving different instructions. Staff cannot identify the current approved version. Someone proposes deleting every older copy without checking historical-record needs. Children remain in care while this decision is being made. Another worker suggests dealing with the records before changing the arrangement.
scenario_zh: 两版政策同时在用，说明不一致。员工不知道哪版现行有效，有人提议不查历史保留需要就把所有旧版删掉。作出决定时，孩子仍在现场。另一名员工建议先处理记录，再改变眼前安排。
question: As director, how would you establish one current working version while preserving required historical records? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样确立一个现行工作版本，同时保存需要保留的历史资料？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Label the current policy, remove outdated working copies from daily use, and keep historical copies where required. Ask staff to explain the changed step.
required_zh: 标明现行版本，移走日常工作中的旧副本，按要求保留历史档案，并确认员工理解变更。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Outdated handbook”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Two active versions can lead staff to follow conflicting instructions. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“手册过时”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。两版手册同时使用，容易导致做法冲突。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

title: Rule update rumor — Pressure for an exception
title_zh: 规则更新传闻 — 要求破例
scenario: A social-media post claims a rule changed. The effective official text and license-category coverage are not available in the file. Staff want to change practice immediately using another provider's summary. Someone asks you to overlook the concern just for today because changing plans would be inconvenient. The relevant facts and any claimed exception have not changed.
scenario_zh: 社交媒体说规则改了，档案里没有有效官方原文和许可适用范围。员工想立即照另一经营者的摘要改变做法。有人希望今天先通融，因为改变计划不方便。但实际情况和所谓例外，并没有因此得到确认。
question: As director, what issuing-source text, effective date and applicability must be confirmed before changing practice? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?
question_zh: 作为园长，改变做法前，必须确认签发机构的什么原文、生效日期和适用范围？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？
required: Find the issuing authority's effective text and check its date and scope before changing practice. Keep the social media post as a lead, not as the rule.
required_zh: 找到签发机构的现行文本，查日期、适用范围和例外后再改做法，并安排后续更新检查。
practical: Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.
practical_zh: 平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Rule update rumor”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A social-media claim is a lead, not proof of an effective rule. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“规则更新传闻”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。社交媒体消息只是线索，不是规则已生效的证明。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify policy maintenance, accountability, record integrity, and rule updates for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证政策维护、责任、记录诚信与规则更新规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Staff want to change practice immediately using another provider's summary. An authorized reviewer asks what you knew, what you did and how you decided whether the issue was resolved. The team has some records but also unresolved facts.
scenario_zh: 社交媒体说规则改了，档案里没有有效官方原文和许可适用范围。员工想立即照另一经营者的摘要改变做法。获授权审阅人员问你当时知道什么、做了什么，以及怎样判断问题已解决。团队有部分记录，也有未确定事实。
question: As the family child-care provider, what issuing-source text, effective date and applicability must be confirmed before changing practice? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，改变做法前，必须确认签发机构的什么原文、生效日期和适用范围？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？
required: Find the issuing authority's effective text and check its date and scope before changing practice. Keep the social media post as a lead, not as the rule.
required_zh: 找到签发机构的现行文本，查日期、适用范围和例外后再改做法，并安排后续更新检查。
practical: Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.
practical_zh: 按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Rule update rumor”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A social-media claim is a lead, not proof of an effective rule. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“规则更新传闻”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。社交媒体消息只是线索，不是规则已生效的证明。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify policy maintenance, accountability, record integrity, and rule updates for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证政策维护、责任、记录诚信与规则更新规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。
